annotations.title: Check an Advisor or Firm's Public Registration

description: Looks up an advisor or firm in the public SEC Investment Adviser Public Disclosure (IAPD) and FINRA BrokerCheck records. Returns registration scope (active or inactive, broker-dealer and/or investment adviser) and whether either record lists a disclosure event. The searched name is sent to those two public services. A starting point for due diligence, not a substitute for the full public record.

query.description: The advisor or firm name to search for

search_type.description: Whether to search for a person or a firm
